title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: Resolve-public/writing-assistant-chat
description: AI writing assistant for Obsidian with chat, plan, and edit modes. Connects to local or cloud LLM providers. Features vault-wide RAG retrieval, knowledge graph, agentic tool use, note context, and reusable prompt commands.

title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent
description: TypeScript AI agent orchestration framework with dynamic workflows. Describe the goal, not the graph: a coordinator plans the task DAG at runtime and runs it on any LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or local models).

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it eliminates the need to re-explain context every time you switch tools or devices. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: syedahmad0786/flowsentry
description: AI ops agent for n8n — detects failure spikes, latency anomalies, and error clusters in workflow executions, then writes LLM root-cause digests to Slack. Free local Ollama or Groq.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: kane-mar/bash-agent
description: A minimal AI agent loop written entirely in bash in under 100 lines of code. It calls LLMs via OpenRouter, DeepSeek, or OpenAI, runs tools (bash, read, write, edit), and can import skills

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: agentd-dev/source-code
description: A minimal, MCP-native, cloud-native AI agent runtime. One small static Rust binary runs one agent: hand it an instruction and one LLM endpoint, and it runs the agentic loop — think, call a tool, observe, repeat — until the task reaches a terminal status or a new event wakes it.

title: Tiny-Bubble-Company/meerkat
description: Open source API for async AI agent tasks. Describe work in plain English, bring your own LLM key, and get signed webhooks when things change — package tracking, website monitoring, price alerts, and more. Self-host (MIT) or use Meerkat Cloud.

title: Orkas-AI/Orkas
description: Open-source multi-agent AI desktop client — build and command your AI agent team through conversation. A commander LLM dispatches sub-agents in parallel or in series; agents self-evolve via reflection and skill crystallization. Local-first, BYO LLM keys (Claude · OpenAI · Gemini · DeepSeek · Kimi · GLM · Qwen). macOS / Windows / Linux.

title: codeproxy-ai/core
description: @codeproxy/core is a zero-dependency TypeScript library that converts upstream LLM responses in Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages format into the OpenAI Responses API format, so that AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code can work with any language model.

title: Tokfinity/InfCodeX
description: A lightweight AI coding agent that actually works. InfCodeX is modular, zero-config, and supports multiple LLM providers out of the box. Use it as a CLI tool or npm library—with session memory, parallel execution, and agent teams. Written in TypeScript.

title: SECBLOK/belay
description: AIDefender is a local security layer that sits at the tool-call boundary of your AI coding agents. It blocks the dangerous stuff outright, asks you about the rest, and never lets a single agent misstep leak your secrets or wreck your host — in under 100 milliseconds, with no LLM in the decision path.

title: dariank38/agentic-job-scraper
description: # Agentic Job Scraper - an AI-powered job monitoring system that scrapes Telegram channels, RSS feeds (V2EX, 电鸭社区), and job boards (Bossjob.com), analyzes postings with Ollama or NVIDIA LLMs, and helps developers track job opportunities with built-in AI resume generation, enhancement and scoring.

title: ashok-kallara/semantic-daily
description: A 100% free agentic news aggregator that discovers trending AI & technology content from Native APIs (Reddit, Bluesky, GitHub, RSS, HackerNews, YouTube, and Exa.ai) — deduplicates, categorizes using a multi-agent LLM pipeline over OpenRouter, and delivers a curated daily digest directly to your Telegram or as a Web Dashboard.

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.
